title: loop-dispatch route map
description: The extension point that maps a GitHub webhook event to a loop. route-event.sh resolves a route by finding the FIRST rule whose fields all match the event; unmatched events resolve to route=none (a quiet no-op). The rules below are the built-in defaults; a consumer extends routing by shipping its own route-map.json (same schema) — add rules for extra labels, or point an existing label at a different loop.

event.description: GitHub event name (pull_request_target is normalised to pull_request before matching).

label.description: Optional. If set, the event's label must equal this.

state.description: Optional. If set, the event's (lowercased) review state must equal this.

route.description: The loop this rule dispatches to (the skill loop-dispatch invokes). route=none is reserved for 'no match'.
